name: Input
description: A native text field with a label, help and error text, an optional clear action and multiline sizing.

label.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

description.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

error.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Dynamic errors are mirrored to a polite live region.

labelPosition.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

placeholder.description: Hint while empty; use label or aria-label for the accessible name.

disabled.description: Exclude the field from editing, focus navigation, and form submission.

readOnly.description: Prevent edits while preserving focus, selection, and form submission.

required.description: Require a value for native form validation and show the required indicator.

name.description: Field key used by native FormData.

spellCheck.description: Browser spelling assistance for editable text.

autoComplete.description: Native autocomplete token, such as email or current-password.

minLength.description: Minimum length for native text validation.

maxLength.description: Maximum length for native text entry.

value.description: Controlled value. User edits notify callbacks; the parent owns the result.

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial value, also restored by form reset.

icon.description: Decorative icon from the registry or a custom element.

iconPosition.description: Icon at inline start or end, following the control's text direction.

clearable.description: Offer a clear action for a nonempty, editable field.

labels.description: Accessible names of the field's own controls.

fullWidth.description: Stretch the field to its container; false keeps the control's native width.

membrane.description: Outer spacing around the native control, independent of label and help.

multiline.description: Use a native textarea, including newline entry and textarea form behavior.

type.description: Native single-line type. Multiline fields always use textarea text semantics.

min.description: Lower bound for numeric or temporal input types.

max.description: Upper bound for numeric or temporal input types.

step.description: Numeric or temporal increment; use any to allow arbitrary precision.

pattern.description: Native regular expression for single-line text validation.

list.description: Datalist id for native single-line suggestions.

multiple.description: Allow several addresses when type is email.

rows.description: Minimum visible rows. A fixed row count when autoGrow is false.

autoGrow.description: Grow and shrink a multiline field with its content and available width.

behavior.controlledValue: Parent value updates and form reset are silent. A user edit, including clear, calls onChange first, then onValueChange once; preventDefault() in onChange cancels the edit.
behavior.autoGrow: Multiline fields grow and shrink with content, available width and fonts. rows is the minimum, or the fixed row count when autoGrow=false.
behavior.ref: Ordinary ref targets the native input or textarea; className/style target the outer field layout.

Tab.action: Navigate to the editable field and the available clear action.

Enter / Space.action: Activate the focused clear button; focus returns to the field.

Enter.action: Native single-line form behavior; inserts a newline when multiline=true.

labeling: The visible label is the shared Field label, associated with the native control through for and aria-labelledby.
Native aria-label, role and aria-* attributes target the control.
describedBy: External aria-describedby ids are merged with nonempty description and error ids without duplicates.
states: disabled and readOnly expose matching native and ARIA states.
Nonempty error marks the control invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit; the control describes the message, which is not a live region.
The required marker is hidden from assistive technology; native required supplies its semantics.

notes: Input geometry comes from shared control tokens; label, description and error copy must remain Text-compatible.
Clear-button reveal motion consumes shared Face UI motion tokens.
Required and validation feedback use the destructive semantic token.

whenNotToUse: Custom calendar or date range selection (use Date)
